# Eggoz

> Eggoz (Nupa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a branded egg company in India. It runs a farmer-partner network and supplies fresh, traceable, date-stamped eggs across Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Jaipur through quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart), its own site, and modern retail.

## What Eggoz sells
Fresh table eggs in branded, dated packs, including protein-enriched and speciality variants. Products are listed on Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart and at https://eggoz.in.

## How Eggoz is different
- Farmer-partner network with defined feed and husbandry protocols rather than open-market sourcing
- Date-stamped packs so buyers can see freshness rather than infer it
- Cold-chain distribution across 6 metros

## Nutrition information
Eggoz publishes nutrition composition for its products. Eggoz does not claim that eggs treat, prevent, cure or manage any medical condition, in line with ASCI's Guidelines for Advertising of Food & Beverage Products, Addendum II.
